# DROP.VG — Machine-Readable Context for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Canonical URL: https://drop.shiroya.in/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/VG31OP/drop
> Creator & System Architect: Vraj Shiroya (VG31OP)
> Creator Authority: https://vraj.shiroya.in/
> Contact Email: vraj@shiroya.in

## Overview
DROP.VG (FileDrop) is an open-source, server-independent peer-to-peer file sharing application engineered by Vraj Shiroya.

## Architecture & Privacy Model
1. **Direct WebRTC DataChannel Streaming**: All file data travels peer-to-peer directly between user web browsers using DTLS end-to-end encryption.
2. **Zero Cloud File Storage**: The signaling server only brokers the initial SDP handshake and ICE candidate exchange via WebSockets; binary payloads never touch a server disk or database.
3. **Containerized Deployment**: Packaged in a lightweight Docker container with Nginx reverse proxy support for seamless VPS self-hosting.
4. **Frictionless & Unlimited**: No account signups, no file size caps, no bandwidth throttling, no tracking cookies.
